resources.string: Reads a ZIP file made by Export data, for example from your old phone, and adds its history to this phone. Nothing here is replaced or deleted; entries that are already here are skipped. Counters and baselines belong to the phone that measured them and are not taken over.
No minute-by-minute history in this file, only the other tables below.
This is an older kind of export (%1$s). It holds only the minute samples and the energy per app, so that is all that can be imported.
Entries that are already here are skipped and nothing here is deleted. You can run the import again safely.
This is not an Activity+ export. Choose the ZIP file that Export data saved.
This file was made by a newer version of Activity+ (format %1$d). Update Activity+ on this phone and try again.
This file has a format that Activity+ does not know. Choose a ZIP file that Export data saved.
The file is an Activity+ export, but it holds no history that can be imported.
The file could not be read. Check that it is the whole ZIP file and try again.
Nothing new: everything in the file was already here.
%1$d entries were already here and skipped
%1$d rows could not be read and were skipped
%1$d files lacked columns and were skipped
Something went wrong while saving. What was saved so far is kept; run the import again to add the rest.
